description: Unarmed Minuteman II standing in the Delta-09 launch facility silo under a glass cover; the last intact Minuteman II system in the United States in disarmed and demilitarised condition; Delta-09 is a free walk-up stop at Interstate 90 exit 116 and the National Park Service plan-your-visit page confirmed it open in 2026
aliases: Minuteman II; LGM-30F; Delta-09; LGM30; LGM30F
